The Partnership Ask

What We're Looking For

We want Friday Pickleball as the title sponsor of Junkyard Season 6. Here's the specific ask - transparent and direct.

🏆
End-of-Season Prizes
Prize fund for our three-tier winner system at season's end:

Champions: 1 paddle per player (9 players)
Runner-up: 1 bag per player (9 players)
3rd Place: Shop credit / gift cards (9 players)

Mirrors what great sponsors have done in previous seasons. These are the moments players talk about.
🎒
Player Pack Support
We're putting together a player pack for the Season 6 launch in early September. Anything Friday can contribute goes in the bag:

Ideal items: grips, edge tape, hats, shirts, drawstring bags, accessories

Co-branded where possible. Open to whatever makes sense on your end - even smaller items go a long way with this group.
👕
Jersey Co-Branding
As title sponsor, Friday's logo on all 6 team jerseys across the league.

54 players wearing Friday branding every Friday morning on court in Gilbert.

Jerseys are being finalized now. If timing allows for print production, it goes on the front. If not, we'll make it happen via heat transfer on the back end - either way, the logo is on court.
What You Get

The Return

Real visibility with a real community - plus content that's actually worth posting.

Grassroots
Local Gilbert Presence
You just moved to Arizona. We are an active part of the competitive pickleball scene in Gilbert. 130+ players, 10 courts, three mornings a week. Friday Pickleball showing up here means something - it's not a distant brand, it's the paddle your neighbors are playing with. Word travels fast in this group.
Content
Content Production
I'm a solo content producer working under @mittz.flix - shooting with higher-end mirrorless cameras and quality glass, giving league coverage a more polished, produced feel than a typical phone clip. No posed shots; UGC-style stories for the casual touchpoints, and more produced weekend recaps for the main feed. Dedicated posts at the start and end of season will feature highlights of our title sponsor - tagged and/or collaborated with whichever Friday Pickleball handles you choose.
League Visibility
Logo Presence on All League Comms
Every schedule graphic, standings update, and player spotlight carries Friday Pickleball branding. Recurring impressions with an audience that's on court every week - not just scrolling past it.
Product
Organic Adoption Already Happening
We already have Friday paddle users in our league without a deal in place. This isn't manufactured - it's real. A sponsorship formalizes what's already true on court and gives us a reason to amplify it all season long.
